tasks.label: [1] 构建本地测试 (Local Test)
args: Write-Host '==> 开始配置本地测试环境' -ForegroundColor Cyan; cmake -G Ninja -B build_test; if (-not $?) { Write-Host '[失败] 本地环境配置失败' -ForegroundColor Red; exit 1 }; Write-Host '==> 开始编译本地测试' -ForegroundColor Cyan; cmake --build build_test; if ($?) { Write-Host '[成功] 本地测试编译成功!' -ForegroundColor Green } else { Write-Host '[失败] 本地测试编译失败' -ForegroundColor Red; exit 1 }

tasks.label: [2] 构建单片机固件 (MCU Firmware)
args: Write-Host '==> 开始配置单片机交叉编译环境' -ForegroundColor Cyan; cmake -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Debug -DCMAKE_TOOLCHAIN_FILE="gcc-arm-none-eabi.cmake" -G Ninja -B build; if (-not $?) { Write-Host '[失败] 单片机环境配置失败' -ForegroundColor Red; exit 1 }; Write-Host '==> 开始编译单片机固件' -ForegroundColor Cyan; cmake --build build; if ($?) { Write-Host '[成功] 单片机固件编译成功!' -ForegroundColor Green } else { Write-Host '[失败] 单片机固件编译失败' -ForegroundColor Red; exit 1 }

tasks.label: [3] 烧录单片机固件 (Flash MCU)
args: Write-Host '==> 开始烧录固件到单片机...' -ForegroundColor Cyan; openocd -f interface/cmsis-dap.cfg -c "adapter speed 2000" -f target/ti_mspm0.cfg -c "program build/MSPM0G3507_FreeRTOS.elf verify reset exit"; if ($?) { Write-Host '[成功] 烧录成功，单片机已重启!' -ForegroundColor Green } else { Write-Host '[失败] 烧录烧录失败，请检查连接或配置文件' -ForegroundColor Red; exit 1 }
